text:
anna_ml: Quick intake — new candidate for onboarding: 'nova-lite-v1' (GGUF available). Want prioritized bring-up for chat + function-calling + structured output. Planning PTQ quant experiments; need checklist and prompt/template guidance.

michael_runt: Can you include target SLOs and baseline numbers? Also which eval suites to run?

anna_ml: Targets: match baseline (redwood-small-2) QA F1 within 2% and <=120ms p95 on ded10-like machines. Datasets: SQuAD subset + internal support-chats + multilingual smoke. Prompt template below.

anna_ml: ```json
{
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a concise assistant that cites sources."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "{{query}}"}
  ],
  "metadata": {"stream": true, "structured_output_schema": "https://repo.internal/schemas/nova_chat_schema.json"}
}
```

sam_devex: For function calling keep signatures explicit and typed. Example minimal tool call we use in infra: 

```json
{
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "kb_lookup",
    "arguments": {"query": "{{query}}", "top_k": 3}
  }
}
```

jia: Quantization plan: PTQ -> eval (QA + hallucination + safety) -> compare A/B vs fp16 baseline. Example commands we run: 

```
./quantize --input nova-lite-v1.gguf --bits 4 --perchannel --out nova-lite-4bit.gguf
./bench --model nova-lite-4bit.gguf --batch 1 --seq 512 --warmup 50
```

ops_bot: Scheduled: reserved slot qa-gpu-7 tomorrow 09:00 PT for 2h (for quant & bench).

michael_runt: My suggested bring-up checklist (short):

```
- [ ] Verify model artifact + provenance (weights checksum, last-modified, source)
- [ ] Sanity generation (short prompts, hallucination spot-check)
- [ ] PTQ quantize (4-bit and 8-bit candidates) + perf bench
- [ ] Run eval suites: QA, safety, multilingual, instruction-following
- [ ] Integration tests: chat template streaming, function-calling, structured output parsing
- [ ] Canary rollout plan: traffic % schedule + automatic fallback to baseline on error
- [ ] Monitoring hooks: token cost, latency p95, error rate, eval regression alerts
- [ ] Docs: prompt examples, tool signatures, schema link
```

anna_ml: I'll run PTQ tonight and kick off evals; tagging @jia for datasets and @sam_devex for template review.

jia: :thumbsup: sharing dataset links and adding eval configs to repo now.

evals_bot: New eval job queued: run_id=ev-20260305-001, model=nova-lite-4bit.gguf, suites=[qa, safety, multilingual], priority=high.

sam_devex: One more note — for structured output we prefer a simple top-level shape: `answer` + `sources` array + optional `confidence`. Example: 

```json
{"answer": "short summary", "sources": [{"id": "doc_123", "score": 0.92}], "confidence": 0.78}
```

michael_runt: OK set priority=P1 for this sprint. If PTQ causes >3% QA regression vs baseline we pause rollout and investigate. :eyes:

anna_ml: Ack. I'll post morning results and attach bench logs + eval csvs.
__notes: Thread captures intake + checklist + code snippets for chat template, function calling, quant commands, and structured output schema. Kept short messages, @mentions, bots, and file links as in Slack.
